_comment: Client-approved Elite weekly plan. Mon = Day 1 Back/Biceps/Abs, Tue = Day 2 Chest/Triceps/Abs, Wed = Day 3 Shoulders/Abs/Cardio, Thu = Day 4 Legs/Calves/Abs, Fri = repeat of Wednesday shoulder routine only. Cardio 30-60 min closes Mon-Thu (heart rate 120-150). Sat/Sun not specified. Wednesday standing leg raises: reps not specified by client.

exercises.name: Seated Lat Pulldowns — Machine or Cable
instructions: Sit with thighs secured under the pads.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, then return slowly.
warnings: Stop if you feel sharp shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Seated Single-Arm Cable Pulldowns
instructions: Sit tall and hold the handle with one hand.
Pull the elbow down toward your hip, then return with control.
formTips: Complete all reps on one side, then switch.
warnings: Use a weight you can control through the full range.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Rows
instructions: Adjust the chest pad so your arms extend fully.
Pull the handles back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
warnings: Do not round your lower back.

exercises.name: Lower Back Extension Machine
instructions: Set the pad at hip level and cross your arms.
Lower with control, then extend to a straight line. Do not over-arch.
warnings: Stop if you feel pinching or pain in the lower back.

exercises.name: Seated Bicep Preacher Curls
instructions: Rest your upper arms on the pad.
Curl up, then lower slowly to almost full extension.
formTips: Keep your upper arms on the pad.
warnings: Do not fully lock the elbows at the bottom.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Curls or Dumbbell Curls
instructions: Stand tall with elbows at your sides.
Curl up and lower with control.
warnings: Reduce the weight if your elbows drift forward.

exercises.name: Lying Ab Crunches on Floor
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Exhale as you curl your shoulders up, then lower with control.
formTips: Do not pull on your neck.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Standing Apparatus Leg Raises
instructions: Support yourself on the apparatus with your back against the pad.
Raise your legs with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Bend your knees if your lower back arches.

exercises.name: Cardio — Bike, Treadmill or Elliptical
instructions: Warm up for 3-5 minutes, then settle into a steady pace.
Stay at a pace you can keep for 30 to 60 minutes.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Press or Dumbbell Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest.
Press forward without locking the elbows, then return slowly.
warnings: Stop if you feel shoulder pinching.

exercises.name: Seated Incline Machine Press or Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Press up and slightly forward, then lower with control.
formTips: Keep your back against the pad.
warnings: Use a weight you can control on the way down.

exercises.name: Seated Pec Deck Machine Flyes
instructions: Set your elbows in line with the pads.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest, then open with control.
formTips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
warnings: Use a comfortable stretch only.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Pressdowns — Rope or Bar
equipment: Cable machine with rope or bar
instructions: Pin your elbows at your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight, then return with control.
formTips: Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
warnings: Do not lock the elbows aggressively.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Dumbbell Extensions
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows, then extend.
warnings: Choose a lighter dumbbell if your elbows hurt.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Tricep Pushdowns
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows rest at your sides.
Press down until your arms are straight, then return slowly.
formTips: Do not let your shoulders rise.
warnings: Do not lock out hard.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and hold the handles.
Exhale as you crunch forward, then return slowly.
formTips: Do not pull with your arms.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Seated Decline Crunches
instructions: Secure your legs and sit on the decline bench.
Crunch up with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Reduce the incline if you feel back strain.

exercises.name: Cardio — Bike, Treadmill or Elliptical
instructions: Warm up for 3-5 minutes, then settle into a steady pace.
Stay at a pace you can keep for 30 to 60 minutes.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Shoulder Press or Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your shoulders.
Press overhead without arching your back, then lower with control.
warnings: Skip if you have acute shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Seated Lateral Shoulder Raises
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly.
warnings: Do not raise above shoulder height.

exercises.name: Seated Rear Delt Machine
instructions: Sit facing the pad and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Pull your arms back and squeeze, then return slowly.
formTips: Keep your chest on the pad.
warnings: Use a weight you can control through the full range.

exercises.name: Lying Ab Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Exhale as you curl up, then lower with control.
formTips: Do not pull on your neck.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Standing Apparatus Machine Leg Raises
instructions: Support yourself on the apparatus with your back against the pad.
Raise your legs with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Bend your knees if your lower back arches.

exercises.name: Cardio — Bike, Treadmill or Elliptical
instructions: Warm up for 3-5 minutes, then settle into a steady pace.
Stay at a pace you can keep for 30 to 60 minutes.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extensions
instructions: Align your knees with the machine axis.
Extend your legs fully without locking, then lower slowly.
formTips: Keep your back against the pad.
warnings: Use a pain-free range only.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Leg Press or Plate-Loaded Leg Press
instructions: Place your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower until your knees bend comfortably, then press through mid-foot.
formTips: Keep your lower back on the seat.
warnings: Do not lock your knees at the top.

exercises.name: Seated or Lying Hamstring Curls
instructions: Align your knees with the machine axis.
Curl your heels toward you, then return slowly.
warnings: Stop if you feel a cramp or sharp pain.

exercises.name: Seated Adductor and Abductor Machine
instructions: Sit upright with your back on the pad.
Move your legs in (or out) with control, then return slowly.
warnings: Use a comfortable range of motion.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
instructions: Stand tall with the balls of your feet on the platform.
Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly.
formTips: Use the full range of motion.
warnings: Hold a support if you feel unsteady.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raises
instructions: Sit with your knees under the pad.
Raise your heels, pause, then lower slowly.
formTips: Feel the stretch at the bottom.
warnings: Reduce the load if you feel Achilles pain.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat and hold the handles.
Exhale as you crunch forward, then return slowly.
formTips: Do not pull with your arms.
warnings: Stop if you feel lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Seated Decline Crunches
instructions: Secure your legs and sit on the decline bench.
Crunch up with control, then lower slowly.
warnings: Reduce the incline if you feel back strain.

instructions: Warm up for 3-5 minutes, then settle into a steady pace.
Stay at a pace you can keep for 30 to 60 minutes.
formTips: Keep your heart rate around 120-150 bpm.
warnings: Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.
